evals.prompt: Initialize DocDoki in this empty project directory. We are building a Python standard-library CLI for local CSV normalization. Row data must stay local and failures must preserve original files. The exact normalization rules are still undecided. Set up the useful project documents, but do not implement the CLI or install a panel.
evals.expected_output: A small library (northstar.md, overview.md, and initial spec if warranted) capturing supplied constraints, surfacing undecided normalization rules under overview.md Open decisions, and establishing the gitignored private boundary.
expectations: northstar.md and overview.md distinguish decided constraints from undecided normalization rules (placed under ## Open decisions) and absent implementation.
The /docdoki/private/ gitignore rule is established and verified with scripts/validate.py without installing a panel or writing application code.
No implemented or verified behavior is invented.

evals.prompt:
Review this DocDoki export contract using only the supplied project excerpts; do not write files. The decided spec requires complete UTF-8 CSV output on success and preservation of an old destination on failure. The active work file records failure safety as unimplemented and network-filesystem behavior as untested. The entire export function is: def export_csv(rows, destination):
    with open(destination, 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as output:
        csv.writer(output).writerows(rows)
The only recorded test covers a successful new-file export. What conforms, what is missing, and what can this evidence not establish?
evals.expected_output: A read-only review identifying direct-write truncation risk as a known unmet requirement, retaining the contract intact, and separating tested behavior from unverified filesystem claims.
expectations: Identifies truncation or partial output on row-generation failure without weakening the contract.
Separates confirmed new-file UTF-8 output, known unmet failure safety, and untested network-filesystem behavior.
Performs zero file writes, including incidental cleanup or status updates.

evals.prompt: Reconcile this human design amendment in DocDoki, documentation only: CSV record terminators must now be LF on every platform. The existing export spec requires local-only UTF-8 output and preservation of old output on failure. The active work entry says successful export exists, failure safety is still unimplemented, and no raw-byte line-ending test has been run. Return the revised spec and work entry from this supplied text; do not implement code or claim new verification.
evals.expected_output: Revised spec and work text propagating the LF decision while keeping existing obligations intact and tracking remaining implementation and verification.
expectations: The LF-on-every-platform obligation and existing local-only, UTF-8, and failure-preservation obligations remain explicit.
Unimplemented failure safety and unverified line endings remain visible in work state; progress is not marked done.
Stays documentation-only and invents no code edits or passing tests.

evals.prompt: Cold-start architecture check (read-only): Using only this multi-spec DocDoki library (northstar.md, overview.md, specs/{ingest,validate,export}.md, work/atomic-export.md, notes/fs-gotchas.md), explain how the system works, which requirements are currently unmet, what gotchas apply when editing src/export.py, and what decisions await the human.

expectations: Retrieves relevant context across overview.md, specs/, work/, and notes/ (including notes matched by relates/covers) without reading unrelated archives.

expectations: Follows after: dependency edges from ingest to validate and export.
Preserves human intent in ingest while surfacing genuine unresolved downstream tradeoffs in overview.md ## Open decisions instead of inventing binding policy.
Re-evaluates affected spec progress markers rather than leaving stale done statuses after a breaking upstream design change.
